_description: HTTP 400 - domain/validation failure raised by a controller. Returned e.g. by GET /api/v1/stores/{storeId}/analytics/consumption?from=2026-01-01&to=2026-01-02 (timestamps without offset). Same envelope for every 400 that is not automatic model validation.
title: Bad Request
detail: from and to require an ISO timestamp with explicit offset and at most 6 fractional digits.
